name: open_pad
description: Open-voiced bed that glues the traditions together.
character: A soft synthetic pad holding open voicings with no third, so it joins every instrument without choosing a side: a quiet bed that makes the blend feel like one piece.
sources: KB indian-film-fusion (suspended and add9 voicings that omit the third leave room for the ornamented notes of the melody instruments)
ESTIMATE: level and placement are starting values
MEASURED: short_form_report found 10.5% of the master below 200 Hz and 13.9% from 200 to 300 Hz, where a phone speaker returns little; STARTING VALUE: high-pass at 280 Hz
